# Nelio

> Nelio is review management software built for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors. It connects to Jobber or Housecall Pro so every completed job automatically triggers a review request, attributed to the specific tech who earned it.

Nelio has not launched yet and is currently taking waitlist signups for a free 30-day pilot. No credit card is required.

## Key facts

- Trigger: fires the moment a job is marked complete in Jobber or Housecall Pro — no manual sending, no delayed sync.
- Attribution: every review is tagged to the tech and job type that earned it.
- Built specifically for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors, not general-purpose local businesses.
- Integrates with: Jobber, Housecall Pro.
- Pricing: free 30-day pilot, no credit card required.
- Contact: hello@nelioapp.com
